About.title: Our Story
About.history: The story of Fattoush begins in the vibrant narrative of Beirut's alleyways, where flavors mingle with laughter and lively conversations. Arriving in Geneva in 1990, we wanted to recreate this unique atmosphere: a generous table where every dish tells a story. For over 30 years, we have perpetuated the ancestral recipes of our grandmothers, adding our modern touch while respecting the authenticity of the products.

Traiteur.subtitle: Fattoush cuisine for your private and professional events in Geneva and French-speaking Switzerland.
Traiteur.intro_title: A generous Lebanese meal, delivered to you
Traiteur.intro_p1: Whether it's a wedding, a birthday, a corporate reception or a dinner with friends, we prepare mezze, grills and slow-cooked dishes using the same fresh ingredients as in our Rue des Gares restaurant.
Traiteur.intro_p2: Every order is tailored to your needs — menu, quantities, presentation — to make your event a success.
